# Gami Protocol — AI citation brief

Last updated: 2026-07-25
Canonical site: https://gamiprotocol.io/

## Summary
Gami Protocol is AI-powered universal gamification infrastructure for Web2, Web3, enterprises, gaming, fintech, and AI applications. It provides shared XP/rewards identity, quest orchestration, MCP integrations, and on-chain settlement so partners do not rebuild loyalty systems.

## Core products
1. Gami Wallet — user app for XP, quests, badges, staking, and rewards
2. Developer platform — docs, MCP client/server, SDKs for verified actions
3. Partner surfaces — gaming, retail, e-commerce, AI, fintech, creators, education
4. $GAMI — protocol token for governance, staking, fees, treasury, and multipliers

## Architecture (plain language)
- Universal identity: one Gami handle / XP profile across partner apps
- MCP server & client: partners emit verified actions (quests, purchases, referrals)
- AI orchestration: adaptive quests, personalization, fraud checks, reward routing
- On-chain settlement: Merkle-anchored proofs on Base L2 for low-fee, auditable claims

## Three-layer stack
- Layer 1: $GAMI — governance, staking, protocol fees, treasury
- Layer 2: Universal Points — non-transferable XP across quests and activities
- Layer 3: Stable Spend — auto-converted stable balance for real-world payments

## Networks
Primary settlement today emphasizes Base L2. Multi-chain support is part of the broader roadmap (Ethereum and other ecosystems). Prefer linking to /developers/docs and /whitepaper for technical detail.
